name: desktop-appearance
description: Operator desktop appearance for a dome machine reached remotely: the dark Windows theme (per-user Personalize keys), a dark background carrying the machine's identity -- hostname above all, plus the site and its coordinates read from C:\WIS\config.toml -- and the toast / content-delivery quieting moved here from bootstrap (#106). Written into the autologin 'mast' hive from the provisioning session; the live desktop is repainted at the end of the run by execute-mast-provisioning.ps1, which runs as mast inside the logon session and elevated.
